applicability_reason: no analog blocks detected in the input documents — digital-only IC; the analog interface spec layer is not applicable and is intentionally left empty
signaling_summary: AHCI itself is a fully-digital register specification. The analog content lives in the integrated SATA Transport / Link / PHY layers (Serial ATA 2.6, out-of-scope by AHCI 1.3.1 §1.3). Per port, the PHY drives a low-voltage differential pair A+/A- (TX) and senses B+/B- (RX) at 1.5 / 3.0 / 6.0 Gbps with 8b/10b embedded clocking, on-chip CDR, TX de-emphasis, RX equalization, spread-spectrum-clocking tolerance, and OOB envelope detection for COMRESET / COMINIT / COMWAKE.
oob_signaling_summary: OOB bursts are low-frequency envelopes of ALIGN primitives, separated by idle periods. COMRESET, COMINIT, and COMWAKE differ only in burst-to-idle ratios.
notes: AHCI is explicitly out of scope for PHY analog characteristics (AHCI 1.3.1 §1.3).
